parsed.rationale: This is a regular narrow-complex sinus rhythm at about 75 bpm with a normal axis and no pathologic Q waves, and the only ST change is mild concave J-point elevation with tall upright T waves in V2–V4 (a benign early-repolarization pattern), so there is no convex or territorial ST elevation, no reciprocal depression, and no STEMI-level elevation.
